name: case5_base_t1
classification: Mathematical reproduction on an unmodified public MATPOWER network; no paper-instance claim
notes: The public case5 network and all five linear MATPOWER generation costs are used without modification.
MATPOWER supplies no paper-compatible reserve requirement or ramp profile, so the one-period base case uses zero reserve requirements and has no inter-period ramp rows.
Branches with RATE_A=0 remain in the DC topology but are not assigned invented thermal limits.
